errors.text_span: “实际识别”、“颜色识别”、“异常识别”、“空间识别”和“同位识别”
errors.evidence: x-axis categories are incorrectly labeled. Correct labels are 实体识别、角色识别、异常识别、空间推理和同义识别.

errors.text_span: 蓝色柱状图表示总数，而橙色柱状图表示验证结果
errors.evidence: Blue bars represent training set quantities, not total counts. Orange bars represent validation set quantities.

errors.text_span: 最高的蓝色柱状图的高度约为1102
errors.evidence: The highest blue bar is 1210 (空间推理), not 1102 (实体识别).

errors.text_span: 橙色柱状图的距离范围为5至250
errors.evidence: Orange bars range from 40 (异常识别) to 675 (空间推理), not 5 to 250.
The highest accuracy is 0.8714 (角色识别), not 0.9.
The description does not state the chart's purpose regarding training/validation set distribution and accuracy.
The description omits the right y-axis label (准确率) and its range (0 to 1).
The description incorrectly states the y-axis tick interval as 100 instead of 200.
The description does not mention specific numerical values for training/validation sets or accuracy for any category.
The description does not mention the accuracy trend (gray line) or its values for any category.
The categories are not sorted alphabetically; they follow a logical task-based order.

errors.text_span: 柱状图未按任何特定方式排序
errors.evidence: The description implies no order, but the categories follow a logical sequence.

errors.text_span: 此柱状图展示了总计数据的分类，并展示了包含该数据点的因素
errors.evidence: Vague phrasing; does not clearly state what the chart represents.

errors.text_span: 灰色线条，垂直轴上最多约为0.9，水平轴上约为“空间识别”
errors.evidence: Overgeneralizes the accuracy line's peak; does not specify it corresponds to 角色识别 (0.8714).

errors.text_span: 该图包含一个由蓝色柱状图组成的集合，并配备了橙色柱状图的第二个集合
errors.evidence: Awkward phrasing; '配备' is an unnatural choice for describing grouped bars.
